baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus is only the bare coordination of Pharaoh and Thamud, one ordinarily recognized as a ruler-title and the other as a people-name.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coordination places unlike political scales on one line: a ruler can stand for his regime, while a people-name can stand for its whole civilization. Their shared class is therefore concentrated, historically memorable power rather than a single ethnicity or location.

changed_reading.before: Two unexplained names are merely listed.
changed_reading.after: A ruler-regime and a people-civilization are paired as two scales of formidable but finite power.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: No verb, fate, accusation, or description accompanies the two names; the conjunction is the focus verse's only explicit relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe ellipsis makes each name a retrieval cue for an already recognizable narrative, while the conjunction asks the listener to compare the recalled histories without spelling out one common predicate.

changed_reading.before: The verse supplies an incomplete historical label.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs mnemonic compression: two names summon whole histories and leave several grounds of comparison live.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ordinary knowledge associates Pharaoh with a riverine imperial state and Thamud with an Arabian, rock-built people; the focus itself tightly joins the names.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pairing samples different environments and organizations of durable power. It can therefore widen the warning from one dynasty or terrain to civilizations that secure themselves through very different material arrangements.

changed_reading.before: The pair repeats one generic example of ancient opposition.
changed_reading.after: The pair spans distinct political and material ecologies, making no form of civilizational durability an exemption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding report and its plural hosts convert both proper names into metonyms for coordinated systems. The asymmetry between one ruler-title and one people-name is no defect: each names a different way that collective force acquires a single public face.

activation_trace.role: Renewed speech and news supplies a report that can reactivate old events, making the focus names live narrative payload rather than inert labels.
A mutually supporting collective supplies the army image and lets each proper name stand functionally for an organized network of power.

structural_cues: The two coordinated names immediately follow the construct phrase about the hosts and can unpack its plural by appositional continuation.
The singular ruler-title and collective people-name coexist under the same plural category.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a renewed report and mutually supporting collectives; I infer that apposition maps each name onto a force system. A live alternative is the narrower reading of two literal armies.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh and Thamud are two famous defeated opponents.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh and Thamud name two architectures of coordinated force, one condensed into a ruler and one into a people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised threat, the paired witness and witnessed, and the later all-encompassing witness create a forensic frame. Within it, the bare names behave like cited precedents: compact cases whose known outcomes testify that organized power is answerable.

activation_trace.role: A threat specifically oriented toward evil supplies the prospective judgment against which the two past cases can serve as precedents.
Presence joined to seeing supplies the witness-event relation and places recalled histories within an observed record.
Knowledge that makes matters evident supplies the evidentiary function: the names become demonstrations, not just examples.

structural_cues: The opening oaths place a promised day beside witness and witnessed before any historical names appear.
The focus gives names without commentary, resembling compact case citations whose predicates are recoverable from remembered outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, observed presence, and evidentiary knowledge; I supply the courtroom arrow from those elements to historical precedent. Witnessing may instead denote broad presence without a forensic scene.

changed_reading.before: The names ornament a warning with old examples.
changed_reading.after: The names function as witnessed case precedents entered into the surah's argument about accountable power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pit episode decomposes oppressive force into stationed watchers, deliberate action, witnessing, and the testing of persons. Read through that mechanism, the focus pair denotes social machines that make persecution public and stable, not merely troops that meet another army in battle.

activation_trace.role: Sitting for surveillance or ambush supplies the stationed observer whose fixed attention helps organized violence persist.
Bringing an act about supplies deliberate production, assigning the persecuting system an operative rather than accidental character.
Presence with seeing makes spectatorship part of the act's machinery, not an external report after it.
Testing metal or a person supplies the coercive assay by which power tries to expose, sort, or break its subjects.

structural_cues: The pit narrative repeatedly binds perpetrators, believers, fire, sitting, action, and witnessing before the focus names the older hosts.
The focus's ellipsis permits that already displayed mechanism to become the unspoken predicate shared by both names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surveillance, produced action, spectatorship, and assay; I project that mechanism onto the named hosts. They may instead be parallel defeated forces without reproducing every role in the pit scene.

changed_reading.before: The hosts are battlefield-scale military opponents.
changed_reading.after: The hosts are coercive institutions whose force includes watchers, performers, tests, and a public made to witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal sovereignty before the focus and overpowering grasp, throne, effective action, and will before the named hosts reassign the political vocabulary claimed by empires. Pharaoh and Thamud become finite counter-sovereignties whose apparent agency is framed inside a larger agency that can reverse it.

activation_trace.role: Kingship and sovereignty supply the governing scale against which the political stature evoked by the focus names is measured.
Seizing with overpowering severity supplies the reversal force that can overtake powers known for coercive seizure.
The elevated royal throne supplies explicit sovereignty imagery and relativizes every throne or ruling structure summoned by the names.
Bringing action into being supplies effective agency rather than title alone.
Will and volition join effective action, making the contrast one of whose purpose finally governs events.

structural_cues: Statements of dominion, grasp, throne, action, and will surround the transition into the report of the hosts.
Ordinary knowledge of the focus names supplies their association with commanding political power; the packet supplies the counter-frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign images and effective will; I infer a polemical reassignment from the named powers to divine agency. A live alternative is that these attributes only console victims and do not directly contrast the two names.

changed_reading.before: The pair demonstrates that even very strong regimes can lose.
changed_reading.after: The pair exposes rival sovereignty as borrowed appearance: command, throne, and collective force never become final agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning and return make the old pair available as a repeatable pattern; the pivot to present deniers then replays it. Covering and contradicting truth construct an apparent outside, while the following behind-or-beyond and encompassing destruction close that outside spatially. History repeats, but never beyond the enclosing field of accountability.

activation_trace.role: Beginning coupled with return supplies the first half of a recurrence mechanism rather than an isolated past event.
Return after departure and repetition after beginning supplies the temporal arrow by which the named pattern can recur.
Concealing truth supplies the present actors' attempt to cover over the warning carried by the old names.
Opposition to truth supplies the repeating stance that links present denial to the compressed historical cases.
A side that can be behind, ahead, or otherwise beyond supplies unstable exteriority: changing direction does not produce an escape.
Encompassment by dominance and destruction closes the spatial model and turns the named outcomes into the boundary of present denial.

structural_cues: The old names are followed by a contrastive pivot to present disbelievers rather than by an ending formula.
The locative construction places the present actors inside denial, and the next verse places encompassing power around them.
The earlier failure to repent keeps recurrence defeasible: resemblance to the old names is a chosen stance, not inherited identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beginning, return, present contradiction, and enclosure; I infer typological social recurrence and its spatial closure. Beginning and return may instead refer chiefly to creation and resurrection, leaving recurrence only as a secondary activation.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh and Thamud are closed episodes from a safely distant past.
changed_reading.after: They are repeatable configurations of denial that reappear in present actors, already enclosed by the accountability their denial tries to place outside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pair survives as renewed public report, then as recitation associated with majesty, a writable or buildable surface, and guarding. The medium of remembrance has changed hands: vanished powers do not control their legacy; the preserved recitation keeps only their names and makes those names testify against durable power.

activation_trace.role: Becoming the talk of people supplies posthumous public memory, the first medium in which the focus names outlive their powers.
Magnifying by recounting glory assigns commemorative force to the recited text while withholding final glory from the regimes it remembers.
Reading, reciting, and causing to be read supplies repeated vocal transmission of the two compressed names.
A broad surface used for writing or building supplies a material analogy between inscription and monument.
Guarding and watching over a thing supplies the durability of the textual record that now contains the focus names.

structural_cues: The focus reduces two expansive powers to two coordinated names inside a report.
The closing verses move from denial of that report to recitation, majesty, a written surface, and preservation.
Ordinary knowledge of both names carries strong associations with monumental civilization, making the medium reversal visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed public speech, recitation, commemorative magnification, a writing or building surface, and guarding; I infer a counter-monument that takes custody of imperial memory. The primary closing claim may simply concern the revelation's status and preservation.

changed_reading.before: The two names preserve the fame of ancient powers.
changed_reading.after: The preserved recitation appropriates their fame: their monuments no longer govern memory, and their surviving names become evidence against permanence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch of host as rough, stony ground rather than soldiers and leans on ordinary knowledge of Thamud's rock-built setting. It remains anchored in Thamud and in the immediate host construction, but downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for entrenched territorial power, not as the lexical meaning of Thamud or the required sense of hosts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Thamud, coordinated under the preceding category of hosts, ordinarily evokes a civilization materially embedded in rock; Pharaoh supplies a contrasting territorial regime.

activation_trace.role: Rough earth containing stones supplies a terrain image that shifts host from personnel alone toward the hardened ground and infrastructure in which power is entrenched.
A long, deep cut in the ground supplies a second image of landscape engineered into an instrument of collective violence.

changed_reading.before: The named hosts consist only of rulers, people, and soldiers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a host includes territorial hardness and engineered ground: power recruits landscape itself, yet that material entrenchment also fails.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the sky root to a visible mark and crosses that image into the witness sequence. It remains anchored in the focus's bare identifying names and the packet's witness-sign branch. Downstream prose should label it latent wordplay or imagistic activation, never a root derivation for the rootless focus words or a claim that the sky expression lexically means marking here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Because the focus consists only of two identifying names, the names themselves can be carried as marks by which historical conditions are recognized.

activation_trace.role: The split target's visible identifying mark supplies an explicitly remote image by which the two names can function as recognizable marks left on history.
A sign that bears witness turns the identifying mark into evidence, allowing the bare names to signal a recurrent condition of power and denial.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh and Thamud point backward to two historical referents.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the names are visible witness-marks by which the same configuration can be recognized whenever it reappears.

strongest_changes: The plural host frame turns a ruler-title and a people-name into two architectures of coordinated force.
Witnessing and promised judgment make the bare names operate as evidentiary precedents rather than decorative examples.
Dominion, grasp, throne, effective action, and will recast the pair as failed counter-sovereignties.
Beginning, return, present denial, and enclosure make the old pair a repeatable but already bounded pattern.
Recitation, writing surface, and preservation produce a counter-monument in which the vanished powers survive only as testimony.
summary.what_was_special: The rootless focus offered no branch-backed morphology, so its live anchors were the asymmetry, coordination, and radical ellipsis of two names. Context branches then activated legal, institutional, political, temporal, spatial, material, and memorial mechanisms without assigning fabricated roots to either focus word.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of the two names after the hosts affects how strongly the appositional unpacking should be pressed.
Associations with riverine empire, rock-built settlement, and monumentality come from ordinary knowledge necessitated by the rootless focus, not from focus citations.
Beginning and return can primarily concern creation and resurrection rather than social recurrence.
The stony-host and visible-mark readings are branch-distant exploratory activations and should not displace the stronger collective-force reading.
